units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:5">Macc. III, 5</cite> <he>אינו חייב … בת׳</he> he is not guilty (of violating the law of <cite ref="Leviticus 19:27">Lev. XIX, 27</cite>), unless he takes it off with a razor. Ib. 21ᵃ <he>כיצד גילוח … זה ת׳</he> what cutting is that with which destruction (of the hair-root) is connected? That which is done with the razor.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:11">Num. R. s. 10<sup>10</sup></cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7:15">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᶜ</cite> <he>לאחר … חוזרת לתַעֲרָהּ</he> after twelve months it (the sword of death) returns to its sheath; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:7">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>לנְדָנָהּ</he>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93">Gen. R. s. 93</cite> <he>אחז</he> … <he>לשולפה מתערה וכ׳</he> Judah seized his sword to draw it out of its sheath, but it would not be drawn; a. e.
